visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a man and a woman on a stage illuminated by bright neon geometric light structures. The man wears a light pink vest and dark pants, laughing and gesturing, while the woman in a beige outfit holds a microphone. (2) A fast-paced montage follows, showing the man in various settings: reviewing documents by a white van outdoors, sitting in a home setting laughing loudly, and positioned in a professional studio chair. His attire changes frequently, including beanies, plaid shirts, and hoodies, with facial expressions shifting from focused to exuberant. (3) The sequence transitions to public and media environments, featuring the man on a game show set, a screen recording of him dancing, and a segment where he hosts an event surrounded by snacks and holiday decorations. He is also seen taking a selfie at a retail store and standing next to a large life-size cardboard cutout of himself in a brightly lit shopping mall. (4) Further clips show him speaking on a stage with 'Meiji' branding, traveling in a car on a highway during sunset, and looking out an airplane window. He appears on various talk show sets and is eventually shown on a large stage with red curtains, followed by a close-up of him holding a commemorative card and facing a crowd of reporters with microphones. (5) The video concludes back on the neon-lit stage from the opening, where the man and woman walk forward and gesture towards the camera, maintaining high energy and cheerful expressions throughout the closing take.
